Generate ONE landscape 16:9 image: a polished 2-by-2 chronological storyboard of FOUR in-game screenshots showing full-body cat grooming. Each of the four equal panels is itself a 16:9 gameplay viewport, thin dark gutters only, no large poster title or explanatory text. Image reference is CHARACTER DESIGN reference only.
Character: faithfully match the supplied chunky white/orange/dark-gray calico cat, thick dark brown contours, pink triangular ears, simple dot eyes, cute chunky four feet, distinctive calico patches and curved tail. Preserve its identity across all four panels. Not realistic fur rendering, not a different breed. Cat lies/rests sideways facing left on a grooming table, body fully visible and occupying about 75–85% of each panel.
Backdrop: exactly the SAME fixed warm dark brown leather padded grooming tabletop, softly shaded pseudo-3D leather grain, subtle stitched outer seam, fixed overhead slightly tilted game camera and fixed warm lighting. No rooms, humans or hands, no restraints. Flat illustrated paper-cut cat in a pseudo-3D table scene, consistent clean contour art and simple shading matching reference.
Panel 1: fully dirty and ruffled body, a clear gray-brown dust/grime overlay on TOP of its unchanged calico coat, visibly tangled clumps, 3–4 readable small cartoon fleas and small bits of lint/trash in the untreated area. The underlying natural dark-gray calico patches must not be mistaken for grime. Mouse arrow cursor near a small pale blue metal comb.
Panel 2: player comb visibly contacting the middle of the cat's back, with a short curved drag trail and mouse cursor on its handle. The swept front/left half is CLEAN and smooth with crisp intact white/orange/gray coat patches; rear/right half still has the dirty rough overlay, knot clumps and fleas. The clean-vs-dirty boundary is visibly the comb's swept path, not a straight split-screen filter. Dirty material flakes off locally; fleas and knots are ONLY in the still dirty portion.
Panel 3: around 80% of body now clean and glossy/smooth; comb is at the rear flank, only an untreated rump/tail-base patch still holds dirt, a knot and one flea. Never show fleas on the cleaned coat.
Panel 4: all body smooth clean and original coat pattern clearly restored, pleased relaxed face, a few removed fur/dust scraps on the leather nearby. No dirt, knots or fleas remain on the body. A small floating coin icon with a plus sign signals service completion, no settlement popup.
Minimal unobtrusive gameplay HUD consistently placed in all panels: tiny comb/service icon upper left, five small rating stars upper right, a narrow completion bar along the bottom progressing from empty to partial to near-complete to full. Small corner panel numbers 1,2,3,4. No extra written labels, no thought bubbles, no RPG timing gauges. The scene should look like actual game screenshots arranged as sequential comic frames, not character concept art. The mouse-controlled comb, local clean/dirty contrast, and fixed scene continuity are the visual priority. Sharp readable 2D game illustration, opaque image.
